sim.title: 3D flight
sim.flown: Flight completed {{date}}: showing the plan as it was
sim.flownNoDate: Flight completed: showing the plan as it was

farm.title: The mission has no farm
farm.body: Import turbines from KML/KMZ or place them on the map — without a farm there is nothing to fly around.

route.title: No route yet
route.body: Build the inspection order on the Routes screen: 3D shows the same flight plan as the map.

speed.title: Drone speed is not set
speed.body: The cruise speed in the drone profile must be above zero: the flight time is based on it.

scene.label: 3D flight scene
scene.unavailableBody: 3D graphics (WebGL) could not start on this computer. Playback, the timeline and the panel on the right work without the scene.

controls.label: Playback controls
controls.hint: Space — play and pause · R — restart · [ and ] — slower and faster · C — switch camera. Free camera: drag to orbit, wheel to zoom; top view: drag to pan.

now.title: Now
now.reserve: The mark is the {{value}}% reserve. Consumption is by flight time without wind.
now.belowReserve: Below the reserve: the rest of the flight would eat into the reserve charge.
now.sorties_one: The route does not fit one battery: {{count}} flight needed
now.sorties_few: The route does not fit one battery: {{count}} flights needed
now.sorties_many: The route does not fit one battery: {{count}} flights needed
now.sorties_other: The route does not fit one battery: {{count}} flights needed
now.sortiesImpossible: The route cannot be flown: the headwind at transit height is close to the drone speed.

weather.title: Weather at departure
weather.none: No forecast for the departure hour: rotors are still, nacelles face west.

conflicts.text_one: {{count}} route segment passes too close to a tower — it is marked red.
conflicts.text_few: {{count}} route segments pass too close to towers — they are marked red.
conflicts.text_many: {{count}} route segments pass too close to towers — they are marked red.
conflicts.text_other: {{count}} route segments pass too close to towers — they are marked red.

legend.title: Legend
legend.passed: The part already flown is thicker and brighter.
legend.conflictRing: Tower the route comes too close to
legend.currentRing: Turbine the drone is flying to or around
legend.droneScale: The drone is enlarged for visibility: {{span}} m span. The path, heights and turbines are to scale.

end.title: Inspection flight complete
end.alreadyFlown: The flight was already completed on {{date}}.
